newsitem.title: ITALY: EIB bond a show of faith in Italy - Treasury source.
newsitem.headline: EIB bond a show of faith in Italy - Treasury source.

text.p: A decision by the European Investment Bank (EIB) to launch a lira bond that can be redenominated in the euro currency is a sign of faith in Italy, a source at the Italian Treasury said on Tuesday.
"There is satisfaction over the EIB decision," the source said. "It's a sign of faith in Italy by an important European institution," he added.
The EIB issued a one trillion lire Eurobond due February 2007, with the paper convertible into euros once European economic and monetary union (EMU) has been completed.
Italy has vowed to be a founder EMU member when the euro is launched in 1999. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
